releases.notes:
Mod AI ban dong hanh cho Minecraft 1.21.1 Java (Fabric). Can Fabric Loader 0.16.14 + Fabric API 0.102.0+1.21.1, Java 21.

Cai dat: copy file .jar vao .minecraft/mods (profile Fabric 1.21.1).

Moi trong v1.4.0 (tiep sau v1.2.0):
- M8a Trang bi: /gf equip (mac vu khi/giap tot nhat), /gf gear (xem dame + giap), /gf unequip (coi do). Dame va giap tinh THAT, luu theo pet.
- M8b Hien do: vu khi cam tay phai + giap hien dung chat lieu tren nguoi pet.

Full lenh xem README.

releases.notes:
Mod AI ban dong hanh cho Minecraft 1.21.1 Java (Fabric). Can Fabric Loader 0.16.14 + Fabric API 0.102.0+1.21.1, Java 21.

Cai dat: copy file .jar vao .minecraft/mods (profile Fabric 1.21.1).

Co gi moi:
- M1 Core: lenh /gf, config
- M2 Follow: /gf spawn|follow|stay|here|goto|dismiss, tu teleport khi lac
- M3 Chat AI: @gf + Gemini online / offline tieng Viet, /gf ask|ai|forget|apikey
- M4 Sinh ton: /gf attack|stop|mine|collect|feed, tu hoi mau
- M5 Polish: luu tri nho AI, /gf config|prefix
- M6 Viec tu dong: /gf minevein|chop|farm, kho pet rieng, /gf bag|give|deposit
- M7 Dang nguoi: model player tay thuong, skin file/URL/mac dinh

Chi tiet test trong README.
